program.title: BSc in Ocean Science and Technology
uncertain: total_required_credits (88.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The program has a mandatory International Research Enrichment (IRE) Track and two mutually exclusive Options (Marine Ecology / Oceanography), so the sum double-counts: OCES 4303 appears in both the IRE Track and the Oceanography Option, and the core already includes capstone/elective credits. A realistic minimum is the core (pre-req 6 + required 34 + capstone 3 + CHEM 3 + LIFS 0 + MATH 3 + PHYS 3 + COMP 3 + LANG 0 + elective 12 = 67) plus the IRE Track (+6) = ~73, plus one Option (Marine Ecology +9 or Oceanography +6).
Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. LIFS 0-3, MATH 3-4, PHYS 3-4, LANG 0-3, capstone 3-6), so actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 OST (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
